question: The Garo, Khasi and Jaintia hills are a subdivision of:
solution:
The correct answer is **Meghalaya plateau**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Garo, Khasi, and Jaintia hills are part of the **Meghalaya plateau**.
 
• The **Meghalaya plateau** is located in the northeastern part of India.
 
• These hills are known for their rich biodiversity and unique cultural heritage.
